# Release wasm sizes, in bytes, for the size-regression check in CI.
#
# CI fails a PR that grows any binary by more than 5% over its baseline. That
# budget is there to catch a dependency or a chunk of dead code arriving by
# accident, not to forbid the contracts growing. When growth is intended,
# update the number here in the same PR and say why in the body.
#
# Regenerate with: make sizes
sh_income_distributor 25881
sh_offering 42489
sh_property_registry 35320
sh_share_ledger 35329
